releaseNotesMarkdown:
### VictoriaMetrics/victorialogs-datasource

### [`v0.34.0`](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/victorialogs-datasource/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#v0340)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/victorialogs-datasource/compare/v0.33.1...v0.34.0)

- FEATURE: expose every log field as its own column in annotation query results, so annotation field mappings can use a single field for `Title` or `Tags`, and a field with an epoch-milliseconds timestamp for `Time end` to draw range annotations. See [#​568](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/victorialogs-datasource/issues/568). Thanks to [@​Danielv123](https://redirect.github.com/Danielv123) for contributing.

- BUGFIX: remove the `Manage alert rules in Alerting UI` switch from the data source settings. Grafana reads its `jsonData.manageAlerts` flag only for the data source-managed rules of Loki and Prometheus, so for VictoriaLogs the switch had no effect: Grafana-managed alert rules could still be created with it turned off. Restricting who can create alert rules is done with Grafana RBAC. See [#​727](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/victorialogs-datasource/issues/727).

- BUGFIX: stop failing every alert rule evaluation when an `Instant` stats query matches no logs and VictoriaLogs returns an empty value (for example `stats max(ts)`). The alerting path now reports the empty value as a null sample, the same as dashboards do. See [#​747](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/victorialogs-datasource/issues/747). Thanks to [@​sarankumar1325](https://redirect.github.com/sarankumar1325) for contributing.

- BUGFIX: show the `Logs sample` in Explore for `Range` and `Instant` stats queries. The sample was never requested, and its query kept the `stats` pipe, so it returned the aggregated rows instead of the log lines behind the chart. The sample now runs the query without its aggregation pipes (`stats`, `top`, `uniq`, `facets`...). See [#​735](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/victorialogs-datasource/issues/735). Thanks to [@​paullacoutiere-oss](https://redirect.github.com/paullacoutiere-oss) for contributing.
